'''Sorgoth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Evocii]] [[Force Adept]] who lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] that he had reached the age of one hundred and fifty, Sorgoth had became the leader of a clan of about thirty Evocii.
